physics.model: Inherited R1/R8/R9 full vector dyadic CM+RR DDA density J=chi E; finite model only
physics.boundary_mixture: Arithmetic cell-volume contrast; same geometric integration coarse/fine; no sphere-MG substitution
physics.current: J=chi Q is normalized contrast-polarization/algorithm contrast-current, not raw physical electric current; j_phys=-i omega epsilon_b J; p=epsilon_b VJ, epsilon_b=1 here
physics.continuous_scope: Finite dyadic CM+RR point DDA only; no continuous-Maxwell accuracy certificate, no original2019 3lambda reproduction

normalizers.physical_Phi: mean_s sum(abs(S J_s-Y_s)^2)/sum(abs(Y_s)^2), no1/2 and R0
normalizers.sigma_ML: Separate raw whitened sum(abs(residual)^2)/sigma^2 and CN99 full-data radius; never call inherited Phi iid ML

cost_prefixes.prefix_selection: minimum public physical Phi among already-paid full physical states whose completion total arm cost is <=budget, including initial/stage/line-trial states; no interpolation or post-budget solve
